title: Nande Koko ni Sensei ga!? Special
justification: AniList 113924 has 1 episode (2019-12-11; English 'Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?: Thirteenth Period', synonym 'Episode 13'). AniDB 14413 S1 'Why the Hell Are You Here, Teachers!?' (なんでここに先生たちが!?) is dated 2019-12-11, the only special. TVDB 359646 0x01 'Thirteenth Period' is dated 2019-12-11. The offline-database title 'Nande Koko ni Sensei ga!? Nande Koko ni Sensei-tachi ga!?' and the synonym 'Thirteenth Period' tie all three.
